subject: Renewal — NovaLedger hosted API: commit increase & tier adjustment
messages:
From: Alex Green <alex.green@novaledger.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@novaledger.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal conversation — hosted API monthly commit increase

Hi Lukas / Marissa,

Quick note to start the renewal conversation for NovaLedger. We’ve been tracking steady growth on our fraud-detection pipeline and expect a 2.2x increase in token consumption next 12 months. Current hosted API monthly commit is 50M tokens; we’d like to discuss moving to a 120M monthly commit and tightening rate limits for predictable latency during peak windows.

Primary asks:
- New committed quantity: 120M tokens / month
- Support for a higher per-minute request rate during batch ingestion windows (we currently see spikes 10–12a UTC).
- Clarity on soft-burst allowances and overage pricing.

Natalie from procurement is cc’d for PO / billing cadence questions. Can we get a short proposal and a ballpark on unit price and any volume discounts? We’re targeting signature by mid-July so ops can plan.

Thanks,
Alex Green
Head of Data Platforms — NovaLedger
--
Alex Green
NovaLedger
From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Green <alex.green@novaledger.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Procurement <procurement@novaledger.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 12:02:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Renewal conversation — hosted API monthly commit increase

Alex — thanks for the clear asks. High level we can absolutely support a move to a 120M/month committed plan and provide a tiered unit rate with a modest volume discount. Draft highlights (attached: NovaLedger_MA_Proposal_v1.pdf and pricing sheet):

- Commit: 120,000,000 tokens / month (12 month term)
- Unit price: $0.0012 / input token; $0.0018 / output token (reflects ~8% blended discount vs current list)
- Soft-burst: up to 30% sustained above baseline for short windows (5–15 min) before graceful throttling — no additional charge if within monthly usage bucket
- Peak request rate: we can raise the account-level RPS allowance for the ingestion windows to 350 requests/minute with autoscale headroom to 600 RPM for short bursts; we’ll also provide an SLA note covering regional fallback.
- Overages: billed monthly at 1.25x the committed unit rates, with an option to apply a temporary surcharge waiver during first-month transition if commit ramp happens on schedule.

Operational notes: Karthik will validate the burst headroom with infra and confirm KV-cache warmup guidance for your parallel ingest job. We’d like to schedule a 30-min ops runbook call to align on sequencing (cache priming, warm-up tokens, and failover region).

Next steps suggested:
1) You confirm the commit and term length (12 vs 24 months).
2) We issue a formal proposal (attached) and provisional invoice schedule.
3) Legal/billing review and signature (we can provide DocuSign).

I’ll leave Karthik and Marissa to add operational / billing detail below.

Best,
Lukas Meyer
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference
--
Lukas Meyer
Redwood Inference
From: Alex Green <alex.green@novaledger.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Procurement <procurement@novaledger.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2026 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal conversation — hosted API monthly commit increase

Thanks Lukas — this is helpful. A couple of clarifying questions before we lock term: 

1) For the soft-burst and peak RPM, how do you monitor/notify us before throttles kick in? We need a predictable alerting window to route traffic to fallback instances.
2) If we ramp faster than expected and exceed commit in month 1, can that overage be credited back if we commit to a 24-month term?
3) Procurement: please confirm required PO format and if Redwood supports net-45 invoicing.

If those items look good we can move toward a 12-month or 24-month signature depending on the discount you can offer for longer commitment.

Appreciate it — I’ve penciled a 30-min call Thurs 6/24 10am PT if you can make it.

— Alex
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Green <alex.green@novaledger.com>, Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2026 10:14:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Renewal conversation — hosted API monthly commit increase

Alex — quick operational detail from infra: 

- Monitoring & alerts: we’ll configure an account-level alert in the console that fires when 85% of committed tokens are consumed in a rolling 24-hour window and a second alert at 95% consumption. We also emit token-level and request-rate metrics to your chosen Datadog workspace (we can share a read-only token).
- Throttling behavior: graceful 429s with Retry-After and a prefailure hook where we attempt best-effort route to a non-peak region if enabled on your account. Failover adds ~40–80ms p50 extra latency.
- Overage credit: we can include a clause for a one-time overage credit up to the value of the difference between 12- and 24-month blended pricing if you convert to a 24-month commitment within 60 days of the invoice.

Also: for the ingestion windows you mentioned, we recommend a small prefix cache warm-up the hour before the spike (we can provide a script) to reduce cold-KV latencies. I’ll attach the warm-up checklist to the ops notes in the proposal.

— Karthik
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Green <alex.green@novaledger.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Procurement <procurement@novaledger.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 11:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal conversation — hosted API monthly commit increase

Alex / Natalie — thanks for the fast turnaround. Summary and agreed next steps: 

- We’ll issue a revised MA with two term options: 12-month (120M/month) and 24-month (120M/month) with an additional 7% blended discount on the 24-month option.
- Monitoring: console alerts at 85% and 95%; Datadog integration as Karthik outlined.
- Overage treatment: standard 1.25x billing; conversion credit (one-time) available if you move to 24-month within 60 days.
- Peak RPM: provisioned to 350 RPM with autoscale to 600 RPM burst ceilings; warm-up script and prefix caching checklist included.
- Billing: we support PO + net-45; procurement, please reply with PO number format and billing contact.

Action items:
1) I’ll upload the revised MA and pricing worksheet to DocuSign by EOD — link will include a check-box for 12 vs 24 month.
2) Marissa will coordinate the provisional invoice schedule and confirm net-45 terms.
3) Karthik will send the warm-up script and a short ops runbook before the signature.

Can we lock the 30-min ops call for Thu 6/24 10am PT (as Alex proposed) — I’ll send a calendar invite and include our SRE on the dial.

If that all looks good I’ll go ahead and push the DocuSign and provisional invoice.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this across the line.

Best,
Lukas Meyer
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference
--
